_doc: ADR-0064 D-C/D-003: corpus assets are FOUR distinct classes and never interchanged. This manifest is the machine-read taxonomy; each class delegates its numeric identity to its single home (thresholds.json corpus pin / private_corpus fingerprints / judge-twins line count / devin-corpus manifest). Checked by scripts/check-corpus-classes.js (gates.json: corpus-classes).

classes.role: attribution bench; sole feed of the rung ladder

classes.status_rule: ADR-0060 D-B: n < min_n=100 -> conditional certification only; no conformity statement may cite it; enters NO rung statistic

classes.role: METR Task Standard ground truth (task+setup+deterministic scoring function); collected via the local Devin harness; blind to rung 1 - unlocks only after rung-1 settlement

disjointness.rule: no class may merge into or substitute for another (D-C); devin ids must carry the devin- namespace prefix and collide with neither polygraph pb- ids nor gold20 ids
